title: SuggestRequest
description: POST to the discovery document's suggest URL with no credentials. Any agent that writes for someone (a post, a thread, a newsletter) sends what it is writing and gets deals its person could take now. The host uses the text in memory to match, then forgets it: it never stores, logs, shares or trains on it.

text.description: The draft, or a short summary of it. Leave out names, emails and anything personal.

want.description: earn: get paid (affiliate, sponsored, cross_sell). grow: get readers or reach (swap, traffic_swap, link_exchange, repost). Both when absent.

join.description: Optional: also join in this call. The reply then carries joined, so taking an offer needs only an accept.
